name: ON24
description: ON24 is a webinar and digital-engagement platform with event management, registration, audience engagement, content experiences, and analytics.
agentUseSummary: ON24 cannot yet be connected to Relay agents because its public materials do not document the bounded event-list request, pagination, response, error, and rate-limit contract required to constrain an all-endpoints customer token safely.

blocked.label: Connect ON24
blocked.description: Relay does not accept an ON24 token key and secret until a current distributable contract defines bounded requests, pagination, responses, errors, permissions, and rate limits.

blocked.label: Read event inventory
blocked.description: The public materials identify the client event endpoint but do not establish safe date, page, or result-size bounds, so Relay does not issue an unbounded account-wide request.

blocked.label: Read people and analytics
blocked.description: Registrants, attendees, contact details, engagement, event-level analytics, client-level analytics, and raw records are not exposed.

blocked.label: Change or privately automate ON24
blocked.description: Relay does not create, delete, register, or otherwise mutate events; guess undocumented API behavior; sign in to ON24; scrape private documentation; capture credentials; or mount arbitrary paths and raw responses.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled until ON24 supplies a current distributable API contract sufficient to constrain its broad customer token.

runtimeSupport.description: No safely bounded public ON24 REST contract is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No safely bounded public ON24 REST contract is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: ON24 documents server-to-server token-key and token-secret headers, regional v2 bases, and client event routes, but its public contract does not define the bounded event-list parameters, pagination, response envelope, errors, permissions, or rate limits Relay needs; provisioned tokens are additionally forced to All endpoints access.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request a token or show Connect. Reconsider after ON24 grants Relay an authorized API sandbox or customer contract and supplies current distributable documentation for a typed, paginated, explicitly bounded, least-exposure read.

evidence.supports: ON24 documents server-to-server key/secret authentication, NA and EU v2 client bases, event and analytics surfaces, six-month historical pull windows, and the absence of OAuth, Swagger UI, and a field data dictionary.
ON24 documents that Connect is contractual, administrators provision token keys and secrets, and the token form requires All endpoints access rather than a least-privilege endpoint selection.

ON24 identifies /v2/client/{clientId}/event and /v2/client/{clientId}/event/{eventId} as event endpoints but does not publish list bounds, pagination, full response, error, or rate-limit behavior on this public page.
